typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		AgreementType as string,
		Account as string,
		Group as string,
		Company as string,
		ProductType2 as string,
		ProductType1 as string,
		InstrumentDescription as string,
		SourceSystemName as string,
		HoldInCustody as string,
		FundedRate as string,
		CollateralMaturityDate as date,
		ActualDate as date,
		RegReportingCounterpartyTypeId as string,
		SourcePositionId as string,
		CollateralMarketPrice as integer,
		LegalOrganization as string,
		RegReportingCounterpartyTypeCode as string,
		GroupDescription as string,
		FitchRating as string,
		CustomerNumber as string,
		CollateralMarketValue as integer,
		ADPNumber1 as string,
		Currency as string,
		LegalId as string,
		TradeNumber as string,
		TradeDate as date,
		LegalType as string,
		Division as string,
		CustomerName as string,
		CountryCode as string,
		SettleDate as date,
		FundedPrincipal as string,
		GSCC_Indicator as string,
		MaturityDate as date,
		DivisionDescription as string,
		CustomerType as string,
		MoodyRating as string,
		CollateralFactor as string,
		InventoryDescription as string,
		LegalDescription as string,
		CustomerTypeDescription as string,
		AU as string,
		SPRating as string,
		Instrument as string,
		Country as string,
		CollateralOriginalFace as integer,
		Inventory as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource sink(input(
		AgreementType as string,
		Account as string,
		Group as string,
		Company as string,
		ProductType2 as string,
		ProductType1 as string,
		InstrumentDescription as string,
		SourceSystemName as string,
		HoldInCustody as string,
		FundedRate as string,
		CollateralMaturityDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ActualDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		RegReportingCounterpartyTypeId as string,
		SourcePositionId as string,
		CollateralMarketPrice as integer,
		LegalOrganization as string,
		RegReportingCounterpartyTypeCode as string,
		GroupDescription as string,
		FitchRating as string,
		CustomerNumber as string,
		CollateralMarketValue as integer,
		ADPNumber as string,
		Currency as string,
		LegalId as string,
		TradeNumber as string,
		TradeDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		LegalType as string,
		Division as string,
		CustomerName as string,
		CountryCode as string,
		SettleDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		FundedPrincipal as string,
		GSCC_Indicator as string,
		MaturityDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		DivisionDescription as string,
		CustomerType as string,
		MoodyRating as string,
		CollateralFactor as string,
		InventoryDescription as string,
		LegalDescription as string,
		CustomerTypeDescription as string,
		AU as string,
		SPRating as string,
		Instrument as string,
		Country as string,
		CollateralOriginalFace as integer,
		Inventory as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		AgreementType,
		Account,
		Group,
		Company,
		ProductType2,
		ProductType1,
		InstrumentDescription,
		SourceSystemName,
		HoldInCustody,
		FundedRate,
		CollateralMaturityDate,
		ActualDate,
		RegReportingCounterpartyTypeId,
		SourcePositionId,
		CollateralMarketPrice,
		LegalOrganization,
		RegReportingCounterpartyTypeCode,
		GroupDescription,
		FitchRating,
		CustomerNumber,
		CollateralMarketValue,
		ADPNumber = ADPNumber1,
		Currency,
		LegalId,
		TradeNumber,
		TradeDate,
		LegalType,
		Division,
		CustomerName,
		CountryCode,
		SettleDate,
		FundedPrincipal,
		GSCC_Indicator,
		MaturityDate,
		DivisionDescription,
		CustomerType,
		MoodyRating,
		CollateralFactor,
		InventoryDescription,
		LegalDescription,
		CustomerTypeDescription,
		AU,
		SPRating,
		Instrument,
		Country,
		CollateralOriginalFace,
		Inventory),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
